title: Amalgamated Holdings Limited - proposed acquisition of Sunshine Cinemas Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties. ACCC requested further information from the acquirer. ACCC timeline suspended.
ACCC received further information from the acquirer. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the following relevant markets: - the exhibition of film in a cinema on a local basis; - the exhibition of digital slide cinema advertising and filmed cinema advertising on a local and national basis, respectively; and - the national acquisition of film product from distributors for exhibition at a cinema.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets due to: - the limited overlap between the customer catchment areas of the target cinema and the acquirer's nearest cinema at Maroochydore; - the small incremental increase in total advertising exhibited by Amalgamated Holdings Limited in Australia as a result of the proposed acquisition; and - the small incremental increase in Amalgamated Holdings Limited's acquisition of film product from distributors in Australia as a result of the proposed acquisition.
